about: The FoG pair rule at the edges of the sigma_v prior. O_ij = int n_i n_j dz / sqrt(int n_i^2 dz int n_j^2 dz) of two bins' Fingers-of-God-blurred n(z) (a Gaussian of sigma_z = (1 + zbar_i) sigma_v/c truncated at 4 sigma_z, scripts/make_desi_pairs.py); the paper pair list holds every pair with O_ij >= 1e-6 at the fiducial sigma_v. max_unlisted: the largest O_ij over the pairs outside the layout's pair list, with every sigma_v group at fiducial + t prior widths, t = k s (k: the offset in prior widths; s: the width factor of the prior-width scan), on the grid t; pair_at_t: the pair that reaches it (bins numbered from 0). crossing_t: the t at which max_unlisted first reaches each level (log-interpolated; null: not within the grid). alpha2_to_sigma_v: per cut, each group's sigma_v shift per unit alpha_2 of the alpha_0-only fit (model A + tilts, pessimistic prior; sigma_v on its prior or flat; linear response) and the |alpha_2| of each sign at which an unlisted pair reaches O = 1e-6. paper_sigma_v_range: the largest unlisted O_ij at the +2 sigma edge of the prior and at +2 posterior widths of model B + tilts. Written by EXAMPLE_EVALUATE_FISHER_MODEL_B.ipynb (section 11, item 6).
